additional_info.subject: slac communication problems, Rennbahnstraße 26, 22111 Hamburg
additional_info.body:
Hello,
My name is Benjamin Perske and I’m working for the company AKKODIS on a BMW charging infrastructure project.
Recently one of our drivers had some issues with one of your stations. Charging was not possible because the station did not establish slac communication. With the 3
rd
try the driver finally could charge
Location: Rennbahnstraße 26, 22111 Hamburg
Time: 24.02.2026 [09:52:21]
SerialNr.: MP / P7 170000790-ERK
Are there any know issues with this station? Could you please have a look at it?
Thank you and best regards
Benjamin Perske
Benjamin Perske
Digital Engineer Consultant E-Mobility & Powertrain Leipzig (DCE)

additional_info.subject: ID0483896-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / P7 170000790] Charging Issue CRM:03288000521
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for your response.
After checking the logs of the given timestamp, we see that the charger had troubles with connecting to the EV. In the following log you are able to see that the status `suspendedEV`. Which means the car was unable to connect to the charger.
This happened two times, and after the third time the EV was able to connect to the charger. You are able to see this in the following log.
I hope this clarified the situation.
We see that the charger is not giving any errorflags at that time, so this was a fault on the car side.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
